faqs.question: How is the bill calculated?
faqs.answer: You pay per active employee per month. Employees who exit stop counting from the following month.

faqs.question: Is there a setup fee?
faqs.answer: Data migration and setup are included in annual plans. For monthly plans we will quote any setup work during the demo.

faqs.question: Can we change plans later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can move up a plan at any time and the difference is pro-rated.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can try the product with sample data before committing, and we can load a copy of your own data during evaluation.
